v.s: About what are they asking one another?
v.c: What are they asking one another about?

v.s: About the great news -
v.c: About the momentous news,

v.s: That over which they are in disagreement.
v.c: over which they disagree.

q: Take heed! They will soon come to know
(that it will most certainly take place).
v.s: No! They are going to know.
v.c: But no! They will come to know.

q: Take heed again! They will soon come to know.
v.s: Then, no! They are going to know.
v.c: Again, no! They will come to know.

q: Have We not made the earth a bedding
(a place where they may live in comfort)...
v.s: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
v.c: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺,

q: (to lend stability to the earth, having their bulk underground)...
v.s: And the mountains as stakes?
v.c: and ˹made˺ the mountains as ˹its˺ pegs,

q: (so that you may live in peace and comfort with your spouse)?
v.s: And We created you in pairs.
v.c: and created you in pairs,

q: Made your sleep a means of rest...
v.s: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
v.c: and made your sleep for rest,

v.s: And made the night as clothing.
v.c: and made the night as a cover,

q: ...and the day a means of earning livelihood?
v.s: And made the day for livelihood.
v.c: and made the day for livelihood,

q: Made seven powerful skies above you...
v.s: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].
v.c: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺,

q: (the sun in the sky, which provides both heat and light).?
v.s: And made [therein] a burning lamp
v.c: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp,

q: send torrential rains from laden clouds...
v.s: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.
v.c: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water,

v.s: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.
v.c: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants,

q: (All these phenomena reveal the great creative powers of Allaah. When He can create all these wonderful things, how can the Kuffaar doubt that He can resurrect creation on the Day of Qiyaamah?)
v.s: And gardens of entwined growth.
v.c: and dense orchards?

q: Day of Judgement has been fixed
v.s: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
v.c: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—

q: The day when the trumpet will be blown and you will come
v.s: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
v.c: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds.

q: The sky will be opened and will become
(for the angels to make their entry).
v.s: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.
v.c: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates,

q: The mountains will be made to fly
v.s: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
v.c: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage.

q: Indeed Jahannam is a place of ambush
(where the angels of punishment are lying in wait to punish the Kuffaar)...
v.s: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
v.c: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush

v.s: For the transgressors, a place of return,
v.c: as a home for the transgressors,

q: They will remain there for an extremely long period of time
(without their punishment coming to an end).
v.s: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
v.c: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages.

q: In Jahannam they will taste neither any coolness nor any drink...
v.s: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
v.c: There they will not taste any coolness or drink,

q: (Flowing pus from the wounds of those in Jahannam)...
v.s: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
v.c: except boiling water and ˹oozing˺ pus—

v.s: An appropriate recompense.
v.c: a fitting reward.

q: Indeed they never looked forward to reckoning...
v.s: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
v.c: For they never expected any reckoning,

v.s: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
v.c: and totally rejected Our signs.

q: We have meticulously recorded everything in the book
(their books of actions). (Therefore they cannot refute anything and will be punished for every sin.)
v.s: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
v.c: And We have everything recorded precisely.

q: (the punishment)! (Do not plead for respite because)
We shall increase you only in punishment.”
(Your punishment can only get worse, no better.)
v.s: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
v.c: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”

q: Those with Taqwa shall certainly have success
v.s: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
v.c: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—

v.s: Gardens and grapevines.
v.c: Gardens, vineyards,

v.s: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.
v.c: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age,

v.s: And a full cup.
v.c: and full cups ˹of pure wine˺,

v.s: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
v.c: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—

q: as an ample gift from your Rabb...
v.s: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
v.c: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord,

q: ...Who is the Rabb of the heavens, the earth and whatever is between them and the Most Compassionate, Whom they will be unable to address.
(The people of Jahannam will be unable to request Allaah to grant them respite. The people of Jannah will also be unable to ask for more because they will be unable to imagine anything more.)
v.s: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
v.c: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him

q: On the day when the spirit
none of them will be able to speak except the one whom Ar-Rahmaan permits
v.s: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
v.c: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true.

q: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wills
should adopt a recourse towards his Rabb
(by accepting Islaam and diligently fulfilling the injunctions of the Shari'ah).
v.s: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
v.c: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord.

q: We have certainly warned you of a near
the day when a man will see what his hands sent ahead
and the Kaafir will say, “Oh dear! If only I had been dust
(and did not have to face this day)!”
v.s: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”
v.c: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
